name: Content moderation permissions
description: Adds per-content-type, per-transition permissions on top of core Content Moderation.
project_description:
Content moderation permissions 
 By default, content moderation (core) permissions are on the transition, no matter what content type.

With content moderation permissions, you can give specific permissions by transition by content type.

 If you want to add more granularity on the permissions, you need to remove the permission on the transition (generated by content moderation) and add the permissions generated by content moderation permissions.

 

 Use Content moderation permissions if 
 
 You want to "limit the usage of a transition by content type". 
 You want to "add granularity to a transition by content type". 
 
 Content moderation permissions can do a lot more than that, but perhaps these are some

obvious uses of Content moderation permissions.

 Dependencies 
 https://www.drupal.org/docs/8/core/modules/content-moderation/overview 

 Supporting organizations 
 This project is sponsored by State of Geneva .

 Getting Started 
 We highly recommend you to install the module using composer.

 $ composer require drupal/content_moderation_permissions
